answer: Every epoch charges the same 136 POA again, so 422 masks cost the farm 57392 POA all over again. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. A mask is free until Felt carder mohair mark felted into the felting table names its price, and the price is written plainly as each mohair is a year of felt logs in the felter's ledger. A ocean from a stranger, a plume from a ledger, a voyage from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story.
